questions.question: Three of the following four numbers are alike in a certain way and one is different. Pick the number that is different from the rest.
questions.solution:

All technicians are mechanics.

I. Some carpenters are mechanics.

II. Some mechanics are technicians.

options.text: Only conclusions I and II follow

questions.question:
Which two signs should be interchanged in the following equation to make it correct?

24 - 12 ÷ 4 + 8 × 2 = 11
questions.solution:
Interchanging + and -

24 + 12 ÷ 4 - 8 × 2 = 24 + 3 - 16

27 - 16 = 11

Interchanging + and ×

24-12div 4times 8+2=24-~(12times 8)/(4)+2

24 - 24 + 2 ≠ 11

Interchanging - and ÷

24 ÷ 12 - 4 + 8 × 2 = 2 - 4 + 16

-2 + 16 ≠ 11

Interchanging + and ÷

24-12+4~div 8times 2=12+~(4times 2)/(8)

12 + 1 ≠ 11

Hence, by interchanging + and - we get the correct equation.

questions.question: The average of 9 numbers is 40. If the average of the first five numbers is 38 and that of the last five is 50, then what is the fifth number?
questions.solution:
Total of 9 numbers = 9 × 40 = 360

Total of first 5 numbers = 5 × 38 = 190

Total of last 5 numbers = 5 × 50 = 250

Total of 10 numbers = 250 + 190 = 440

Now 5th term = 440 - 360 = 80.

Hence, 80 is the correct answer.

questions.question: Three of the following four words are alike in a certain way and one is different. Pick the odd word out.

• *This means we should be (3) **careful** not to take anything too far*
 
• **Caretaker **means **a person employed to look after a building.**
 
• **Careless** means **not giving sufficient attention or thought to avoid harm or errors.**
 
• **Careful** means **making sure of avoiding potential danger, mishap, or harm; cautious.**

questions.question:
Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.

The enemy will have seized the fort before nightfall.

options.text: The fort will have been seized by the enemy before nightfall.
The fort would have been seized by the enemy before nightfall.
The enemy will seize the fort before nightfall
The enemy will be seized by the fort before nightfall

questions.solution:
**The correct answer is option 1.**

***The fort will have been seized by the enemy before nightfall.***

The given sentence is in future perfect tense identified by **will have**. Firstly, we interchange the subject and the object while converting it to the passive form. **The fort** will become the subject and the **enemy** will become an object in the passive voice. Also, **been** will be added according to the rules.

So, options **2,3 and 4 **are** incorrect.**
